attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector of the anchor element.

attributes.name: backdrop
attributes.description: Displays a transparent backdrop behind the popover.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Distance between the anchor and the popover.

attributes.name: outside-click
attributes.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Popover placement relative to the anchor.

events.name: tp-popover-toggle
events.description: Emitted when the popover open state changes.
events.detail: { backdrop: boolean; open: boolean; outsideClick: boolean; anchor: string; placement: "top" | "end" | "bottom" | "start" }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-popover>` element implements the <tp-icon name="popover" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Popover functionality: displays anchored popover content.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the page's trigger to open the panel. |
| Using the component | Use its controls or links, then close it with the available dismissal control. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Dismiss the panel when its settings allow it. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
